<html><body>
<p>The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (the &quot;Exchange&quot;) hereby notifies the Securities and Exchange Commission of its intention to remove the entire class of the stated securities from listing and registration on the Exchange.</p>
<p>The preferred stock purchase rights of KLX Energy Services Holdings, Inc. expired by their terms on September 23, 2026, when the stockholder rights agreement was terminated. The rights represent no other right and are no longer outstanding.</p>
</body></html>
